title: Universally slimmable network with width Mirror corrections
hypothesis: On a learnable nested-width classification task, a shared slimmable MLP plus one small width-specific Mirror coordinate will improve narrow-width quality over ordinary US-Net weight sharing while retaining full-width quality, with a useful quality/byte/compute point beyond a matched scalar gate.
physical_object: one max-width MLP whose weights are channel-sliced for widths 8, 16, 24, and 32
mirror_coordinate: one learned Givens angle per supported width, applied to paired hidden activations before the shared readout
logical_multiplicity: four width-conditioned subnetworks from one shared physical max-width parameter set

model.width_sampling: US-Net sandwich-style: always minimum and maximum width plus one uniformly sampled intermediate width each update; same sampled widths across shared variants

controls: independent full model trained for each width (upper/control; all width payloads charged)
shared US-Net nested weights with no width correction
shared US-Net plus one direct scalar hidden-gain code per width
shared US-Net plus one Mirror Givens angle per width
shared US-Net plus width-specific IA3 channel gains (larger native control)
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent-width upper has mean validation accuracy >=0.70; Mirror average NLL at widths 8 and 16 is at least 5% lower than plain shared US-Net; width-32 NLL is no more than 0.02 nat worse than plain shared; Mirror is within 0.03 nat NLL of independent at every width; and either Mirror improves narrow-width NLL by >=10% versus the scalar-gain control at <=10% extra actual bytes or is >=10% smaller than the best quality-matched ordinary control. Otherwise record FAIL/NOT ESTABLISHED and keep fresh sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds: development gates replicate; Mirror width-8/16 NLL improves >=5% vs plain US-Net; width-32 degradation <=0.02 nat; per-width NLL within 0.03 nat of independent; Mirror-specific margin >=10% vs scalar gate or best matched ordinary control; actual serialized payload <=0.90x independent-width payload; active MACs <=1.10x plain US-Net; reloaded metrics/hash replay exact.
failure_gate: Mirror misses narrow-width quality improvement in >=2 fresh seeds; or direct scalar/IA3 control matches within the registered 10% quality/byte margin; or width-32 NLL degrades >0.02 in >=2 seeds; or active MACs exceed 1.10x US-Net.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: all shared max-width weights and biases
all width-specific Mirror angles or scalar gates
width IDs, architecture metadata, and archive headers

compute.mac_equivalent_convention: linear layers count one MAC per weight; each adjacent Givens pair counts four multiplies plus two adds = two MAC equivalents

boundaries: synthetic teacher MLP classification only; no ImageNet or language-model claim
shared variants use common US-Net sandwich width sampling and fixed minibatch sequence
independent width models are an upper/reference and incur separate stored weights
width count is not independent capacity; evaluate actual per-width test quality
fixed-budget evidence is not a near-converged capacity claim
fresh IDs remain unopened until the frozen development gate passes
